title: RAGHub Controller Future Milestones
description: Planning outline for upcoming controller improvements across three phases: foundation, orchestration, and production hardening. Do not execute directly.

metadata.purpose: Structured milestone outline for raghub-controller future work. Convert to a mission via outline_to_mission() before running.

phases.title: Foundation
phases.description: Core controller infrastructure improvements that unblock later phases. Tasks run in parallel.

tasks.title: Context Builder
tasks.prompt: Implement a ContextBuilder class in tools/ai_controller/context.py that assembles a task prompt with relevant repo context (changed files, test output, prior attempt history) so that the AI provider receives a richer, structured input rather than a bare prompt string.

tasks.title: Test Feedback Loop
tasks.prompt: Extend the controller's task execution cycle to re-run the task's test commands after each AI response, capture the exit codes and stdout, and append a structured test-result block to the next attempt's context so the model can self-correct based on test failures.

phases.title: Orchestration
phases.description: Mission-level orchestration primitives. Tasks run in parallel once the foundation phase is complete.

tasks.title: Mission CLI
tasks.prompt: Add a 'mission' sub-command group to tools/ai_controller/cli.py supporting: 'mission start <file>', 'mission status <id>', 'mission resume <id>', and 'mission cancel <id>'. Each sub-command should load/persist state via MissionStore and print a human-readable summary.

tasks.title: Mission Store Hardening
tasks.prompt: Audit MissionStore for race conditions under concurrent controller processes. Add atomic write-then-rename for state persistence, verify FileLock coverage on all read-modify-write paths, and add a store.integrity_check() method that detects and logs inconsistencies between stored state and the event log.

tasks.title: Mission Scheduler Improvements
tasks.prompt: Refactor MissionScheduler to support a configurable tick interval, add a dry-run mode that computes the next set of ready tasks without mutating state, and expose a scheduler.status_summary() method returning counts of tasks by status for use in CLI output and reports.

phases.title: Production Hardening
phases.description: Cross-platform and security hardening tasks. Run serially within this phase to avoid conflicting environment changes.

tasks.title: Windows Compatibility
tasks.prompt: Audit all filesystem and subprocess calls in tools/ai_controller/ for POSIX-only assumptions. Replace os.path usages with pathlib.Path, ensure FileLock works on Windows (use msvcrt-based locking as a fallback), and add a note in README.md listing any remaining platform limitations.

tasks.title: SSH Hardening
tasks.prompt: Review all SSH-related configuration and subprocess invocations in tools/ai_controller/remote.py. Enforce StrictHostKeyChecking, disallow password authentication in constructed SSH command strings, and validate that the configured identity file path is absolute and exists before attempting connection.
